question: to the Commission Elena Donazzan (ECR) Subject:

In the ongoing debate on the Electrification Action Plan, the European Commission is urging citizens, businesses and Member States to speed up the transition to e-mobility, including through significant investments in charging infrastructure. This debate directly concerns the institutions’ in-house management arrangements. This is because the European Commission’s buildings in Brussels and Luxembourg include electric vehicle charging stations that staff members are allowed to use. I therefore ask: who is footing the bill for the electricity that Commission staff are using to charge their personal vehicles at work?
